​Manchester United will embark on the club’s first-ever postseason tour of Asia immediately following the conclusion of the 2024/25 Premier League season.

While the tour is expected to generate approximately €10 million in revenue, it has raised concerns among fans regarding player fatigue and injury risks, especially with some players set to join their national teams shortly after the tour.
Additionally, the club has confirmed participation in preseason friendlies in Scandinavia and the United States later in the summer.
